sections.content:
You know *debido a* and *a raíz de* from B1 Unit 6, *en virtud de* from B2 Unit 27, and *debido a que* from C1 Unit 9. In geopolitical and trade analysis, choosing the right causal connector depends on two distinctions: whether the cause is a noun phrase or a full clause, and whether it is a legal mandate or a material trigger.

*Debido a*, *a raíz de* and *a consecuencia de* all take a noun phrase (*debido al encarecimiento del flete*, *a consecuencia de las medidas arancelarias*). When the cause has a conjugated verb, add *que* to form *debido a que* + indicative (*debido a que subió el flete marítimo*). Never place a conjugated verb directly after *debido a*.

Reserve *en virtud de* for formal legal or diplomatic grounds — a treaty, mandate or clause (*en virtud del tratado comercial*) — rather than physical or market shocks.

sections.title: Prepositional vs clausal cause
rows: general formal cause (*debido al cierre de la aduana*)
full causal clause (*debido a que aumentó el flete*)
structural fallout (*a consecuencia de la represalia arancelaria*)
treaty or mandate basis (*en virtud del tratado marítimo*)

items.spanish: Debido a que se encareció el flete marítimo, varias empresas buscaron rutas terrestres.
items.english: Because maritime freight became more expensive, several companies looked for overland routes.

items.spanish: A consecuencia de la represalia arancelaria, cayó el volumen de carga en la aduana.
items.english: As a consequence of the tariff retaliation, cargo volume dropped at customs.

items.spanish: En virtud del tratado bilateral, ambos puertos redujeron los controles fronterizos.
items.english: Under the bilateral treaty, both ports reduced border controls.

items.spanish: A raíz de la disputa comercial, el gobierno defendió su soberanía regulatoria.
items.english: Following the trade dispute, the government defended its regulatory sovereignty.

sections.content: Never follow *debido a* directly with a conjugated verb (*debido a subió el flete* is ungrammatical: use *debido a que*). Conversely, *debido a que* cannot introduce a bare noun (*debido a que el flete* is wrong).
